All my life I have been creating art. In middle school, I would go on websites and watch pivot stick fighter animations all day. I would attempt my own crude versions at home downloading pre-made assets.”

Alec developed his pixelated world and original character Tri-Tails using free open-source software. “The work that took a team of 40-plus people 20 years ago, I can do in my room alone today. I am excited to see where these tools will take us and what will be made. I am in a server with extremely talented artists, ranging across many different forms of digital art and software. I don’t know what I would do without this community. Having people to reach out to for help and just general questions is something I won’t ever take for granted. This is something anyone should be able to do if they want. It’s our goal to not only inspire but help them achieve that goal.”

Video by @alec.fbx
Music by @goreshit.sucks

“I like to bottle up auras only I can see, in the hopes other people can see them too,” says Nat Ćmiel, the visual artist and musician who is manifesting the otherworldly, ethereal enigma that is yeule (@yeule).

“The yeule project is a sonic and visual time capsule that snapshots eras of my shape-shifting self and the experience of pathos. Musically, yeule lies somewhere between electronic nu-pop cy-earth music II and indie confessional emo.” Born in Singapore and based in London, the self-styled “glitch princess” was a quiet and introverted child before finding their sense of belonging online — drawing inspiration for yeule from the cyber dimension. “As a Singaporean artist, I feel proud of representing Southeast Asia in the electronic music scene. I stand for mental health awareness, trans rights and dedicate my work on this earth to the friends I lost, who couldn’t be seen the way they wanted to be.

I want to hit that spot where it hurts so bad and burns so hot, but you can never take a picture or show anyone what it looked like. Songwriting starts from the dreams and memories that scar the most and end up in my journal in crumpled pieces of paper. I hope it sounds pretty, even though the contents are decaying inside. I won’t sing something I don’t mean, and I don’t play something I don’t really like. There must be a reason why I chip at this concrete so meticulously, right? To make it look as close as it can to what I have seen with my own eyes.”

Video by @yeule

Artist Jon Batiste (@jonbatiste) is a whole vibe. 🎶 He’s heading to the Grammy Awards (@recordingacademy) with 11 different nominations — the most of any nominee this year. 🤯👏

But before Jon’s performance at the awards, he met up with friends in New York City for one of his self-proclaimed “love riots.”

“Love riots are like chaotic, fun, impromptu musical parades. It started as something I would do in transit from one place to the next, whether on the way to the recording studio or to rehearsal or even just to the market,” says Jon. “It borrows from the second-line tradition of my hometown New Orleans, typically starting with a few people and gathering folks along the way. I love the feeling of ceremony and sense of community that it brings.”

Meet Jon’s community and hear his soulful sound from the subway to the studio before tonight’s show in Las Vegas.

🤍🏳️‍⚧️ “Growing up, I never really saw anyone who truly represented me in mainstream media. Trans Day of Visibility is important because it reminds trans people that they are not alone. There are so many people within our community who are making the world a better place. This day represents being bold and thriving in a world that is not always the most welcoming or safe for us.” —Writer and creator Devin Halbal (@devinhalbal)

Video by @devinhalbal

We're on set with Nigerian artist Omah Lay (@omah_lay) who teamed up with Justin Bieber (@justinbieber) for their new single, “Attention.”

“One thing I hope people take away from this song especially is the emotion, the realness,” says Omah, known for his Afro-fusion beats. “It’s always about me telling a story.”

For ceramicist Lisa Asano (@lisa_asano), every new vessel is a new journey. The creation process, the final product and what happens to a piece once it’s in someone’s hands — every step along its way is one worth celebrating.

“Black joy to me is just the most contagious joy. I feel like it’s the most fulfilling and happiest joy that you could ever feel. I’m lucky to say that I’m able to experience that type of joy in my life.”

This Black History Month, we’re continuing to #ShareBlackStories and celebrate Black joy in all its glory.

Nama sang GOAT @leomessi diabadikan jadi nama spesies tumbuhan di Peru. Diberi nama “Salvia messii”, tumbuhan yang ditemukan di kawasan Pegunungan Andes ini dinamai oleh peneliti dari Peru dan Argentina sebagai bentuk penghormatan buat Lionel Messi. Apalagi, bunganya punya perpaduan warna biru muda dan putih yang mirip sama jersey Timnas Argentina.

Masih satu keluarga sama mint dan rosemary, Salvia messii bisa tumbuh sampai sekitar 1,5 meter dan biasa ditemukan di lereng berbatu pada ketinggian 2.000–2.400 mdpl. Tumbuhan yang keberadaannya udah tercatat sejak 2009 ini akhirnya resmi dideskripsikan sebagai spesies baru lewat penelitian yang terbit di jurnal ilmiah Phytotaxa pada 2 Oktober 2026. Sayangnya, Salvia messii juga dinilai terancam punah karena persebarannya yang terbatas, ditambah ancaman kekeringan, kebakaran, sampai perubahan iklim.

biography:
A multi-day gravel festival across the Natural State - returning October 6-10, 2026
Produced by @ozarkfoundation

latestPosts.caption:
The Graveler wrapped, the bikes got washed (mostly), and then a lot of you went right back out.

Last week, 90 Gravelers in the Arkansas Graveler Strava club logged 6,546.8 miles and 330,107 feet of climbing across 315 rides. That’s every foot of climbing from Jonesboro to Arkansas City, ridden 43 times over.

Some rides were long. Julie Fisher put in 101.3 miles in a single ride. Some weeks were full. Brandon Tyler got out 10 times in 7 days. Plenty of rides were a short spin to see if the legs still worked, and every one of them is in that total.

If you rode last week, thanks for logging it. If you didn't, the club is open and we'd love to have you join us:  strava.com/clubs/arkansasgraveler

#arkansasgraveler #gravelfamily

From one end of a long bridge, you can’t quite see the other side. You just keep going.

That’s where we are this week. The trailers are home, the tents are dried and counted, and we’re working through thousands of photos and videos one at a time, because every one of them is somebody’s moment. They’ll be on the website as soon as they’re ready.

The 2026 Graveler is over. We’re not done. It’s quite the opposite. We’re just getting started, and we’re glad to be making this crossing with y’all.

Read The Long Way Across on Field Notes: https://arkansasgraveler.com/field-notes/the-long-way-across

📸: @ben_robles28 / @cloud9media_productions

#arkansasgraveler #deltabluesedition #ridearkansas

Greetings from Helena.

During the King Biscuit Blues Festival, the music doesn't stay on the stage. It spills onto every corner of Cherry Street, and the players are as good as anyone on the bill.

Swipe for the note we'd send home. 📮

📸 @ben_robles28 / @cloud9media_productions

#ArkansasGraveler #KingBiscuit #HelenaArkansas #DeltaBlues

Lee County is one of the most food-insecure counties in Arkansas, and in the nation. Mark and Lucy Smith started Feeding Lee County Together so more of their neighbors have food on the table.

So far, with gifts on behalf of every Graveler, matching gifts from the Ozark Foundation and the Smiths, and an anonymous $6,000 gift from a Graveler, we have raised more than $12,000.

Feeding Lee County Together is the organization the 2026 Graveler supports, and we hope you’ll support it, too.

The link to give is right here: https://arcf.fcsuite.com/erp/donate/create/fund?funit_id=4832

We let the good times roll on day 5 for sure! Day 5 was filled with a long ride, good fun, accomplishment, and so much fun after! Thank you to the entire Arkansas City community for joining us!

#arkansasgraveler #deltabluesedition #ridearkansas

Day 5 came to an end with riders finishing their almost 100 mile ride. Quite the accomplishment! Thank you to the Arkansas City community for showing up tonight and joining us for the festivities and live music!

📸: @chandlerharrismedia

#arkansasgraveler #deltabluesedition #ridearkansas

THANK YOU is not enough to say how much we appreciate our entire @uamsortho team that provided medical support this week! 

We could not make this week possible without this incredible team supporting all of our riders and staff! THANK YOU UAMS!!!

What a day of exploration on day 5! Riders were able to get out and experience a variety of gravel, concluding with a long trip down the Delta Heritage Trail! Riders are now making their way to Arkansas City for the finish.

latestPosts.caption:
🚨 SAVE THE DATE!

Moto Fest returns 23-25 July 2027 to Trac Môn, Anglesey and we CAN’T WAIT to share another weekend with you all.

Here's a taste of what's coming: a bigger Expo with a dedicated road and adventure retail area, a live action arena with an international rider line-up, an expanded MCN stage with more big-name guests, tiered camping (yes, showers and electric are an option), and an expanded music programme with later bar closes 🤟

Same stunning circuit, even more to do 😏 

Tickets go on sale later this year, sign up via the 🔗 in bio to be first in line.

Who's in for 2027? 👇 

#motofest #anglesey #motorcycleevent

Would you try the @superpolepillionxperience 😱 so many of you did this weekend at Moto Fest and LOVED every second of it! 🕺 

#motofest #trialgpanglesey #pillionlap

That's a wrap on Moto Fest 2026! 🙌

To every rider, spectator, volunteer, partner and two-wheeled fanatic who showed up for our inaugural year: thank you. You are Moto Fest 👏

We're already counting down to 2027. 👀
 

#motofest #trialgpanglesey #trialgp

This was only year one 👆 

2027 is already in the works, bigger paddock, more track time, more of everything that made this one worth turning up for.

What moment stuck with you? Tell us below 👇 

#motofest #angleseycircuit #anglesey

Our first time on Track @motofestofficial What an experience it was and now I just want to do it again!! Thanks to Neil @all_torque_and_no_traction for getting the footage, even though it does look like we’re going 15mph. 🙈 #trackday #bikersofinstagram #trackbike #racing #thrillofthegame

The Anglesey Effect 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 

Sea on one side, mountains on the other and every kind of bike in between. Track. Adventure. Road. Dirt. 

This place doesn't pick a lane and neither do we. 2027, we're coming back bigger. 

Who's already counting down? 👇 

#motofest #angleseycircuit #anglesey

Think off-road isn't for you because you're a road rider? Think again. This was one of our most popular activities this year and it's exactly why we built it: no pressure, a coastal trail and a chance to see what the bike (and you) can actually do.

Gravel to dirt to open field, with the sea right there the whole way. This is what "explore beyond the tarmac" actually looks like.

23-25 July 2027. Who's trying it next year? 👇 

#offroadriding #adventureriding #motofest

Ever wondered what it's actually like to swing a leg over a bike you've only dreamed about? 😏 

At Moto Fest, that's not a "maybe someday." Our test rides mean you can try the bike you've been eyeing up online, the one your mate won't let you near or something completely outside your usual lane, all in one place, all in one weekend. 

Adventure, classic, off-road, on-road: if it's got two wheels, there's a good chance you can throw a leg over it here. No commitment, no salesperson pressure, just you, the bike, and Trac Môn's roads and trails to find out if it's love at first ride.

What bike would you test if you had the chance? Tell us below 👇 

#motofest #anglesey #angleseycircuit

We're going bigger and better in 2027.

Off the back of our first year, we're expanding: more Expo stands, more riding experiences, a bigger live action arena, tiered camping (yes, showers and electric hook-up are happening), more food, more music, later bars, and a family zone.

Tickets and camping packages go on sale later this year, register your interest at moto-fest.co.uk to be first in line 👀 

#motofest #anglesey #motorsportevent

SAVE THE DATE 👀 

Moto Fest returns to Trac Môn, Anglesey on 23-25 July 2027.

Bigger Expo, more riding experiences, expanded live action arena, and even more reasons to camp coastside with us. Year two is coming and we're building it with your feedback in mind 🫡 

Sign up to the mailing list (link in bio) so you're first to know when tickets drop! 🙌 

#motofest #anglesey #motorsportevent

The pillion lap experience in one word: unforgettable 🔥

You get on the back nervous, you come off buzzing. That's the transformation we live for at Moto Fest, and those post-lap faces said everything words couldn't.

If you rode pillion with Dan Linfoot this year, tell us: what was going through your head at top speed? 👇

Anglesey, we can't wait to do this again 👊

Could a planet survive the death of its star? 💥

@esawebb has found one: WD 1856 b is a giant planet that circles a dead star every 34 hours. It’s hotter than it should be, which tells us it probably stayed far out while its star died, then moved in much later.

Our Sun will die the same way in about five billion years. So this planet gives us our first look at what could happen to Jupiter.

latestIgtvVideos.caption:
🤘🏻 Большой привет от художников стрит-арт фестиваля «Культурный код» 2022!
⠀
Вчера на открытии у жителей и гостей города была возможность увидеть в живую и познакомиться с райтерами, которые уже прибыли на площадку проекта. Но мы хотим поприветствовать и вас - тех, кто наблюдает за нами в соцсетях. Поэтому ловите большой привет от авторов, чьи работы меньше чем через месяц будут украшать Железнодорожный! А мы пошли на фасады 😉

В «Культурном коде» в Балашихе примет участие известный иллюстратор и художник Антон Гудим!

@gudim_public известен по всему миру своими ироничными комиксами на самые разные темы, а за его творчеством следит более миллиона пользователей. С нетерпением ждем, чем же он удивит нас на фестивале!

Художник фестиваля #культурныйкод в Балашихе - @maxibagnasco! 
⠀
В 17 лет его работы начали публиковаться в книгах и международных журналах. С 2014 года он преподавал реалистический рисунок и живопись, а также разработал методы быстрого обучения и принимал студентов в различных художественных направлениях. Сейчас Максимилиано проводит лекции и продолжает участвовать в выставках и фестивалях. В том числе и в #urbanmorphogenesis! 
⠀
В прошлом году он подарил Солнечнодольску невероятный мурал с писателем Львом Толстым, кого же он изобразит на фестивале в 2022?

Самые внимательные пользователи уже увидели в комментариях к прошлому видео первого иностранного художника фестиваля, котрого мы вам представим!
⠀
На #культурныйкод 2022 приедет @cobreart — художник из Аргентины. Cobre работает в технике гиперреализма. Он самостоятельно учился рисовать муралы и сосредоточил своё внимание на создании портретов. Через изображения людей он показывает свой взгляд на актуальные вопросы современности.
⠀
Солнечнодольску он подарил рисунок бойкой девушки, что же ждать от него в Балашихе? Увидим совсем скоро! А пока дайте знать, что вы рады такому гостю!
⠀
#ПФКИ #urbanmorphogenesis #muralstreetart

🎥 Приехать в Казань и не зайти на аллею «Белые цветы», где в прошлом году прошел фестиваль «Культурный код», большая ошибка. Вот и Валдис Пельш, снимая свой фильм-путешествие по Татарстану, не прошел мимо наших муралов. 
⠀
Одним из героев ленты @pelshtv стал @rustamqbic — казанский художник и райтер нашего фестиваля. Кстати, вы тоже можете стать частью нашей команды, ведь open call для художников открыт и мы уже принимаем множество заявок на новый сезон. Не откладывай на потом, если податься можно уже сейчас! 
⠀
📲 Ссылка на полный фильм будет ждать вас в сторис, познакомьтесь с Татарстаном и его талантами ближе 😉

#ПФКИ #urbanmorphogenesis #культурныйкод

🎄Это был прекрасный год, наполненный творчеством и приключениями! За это время проект побывал в Нижнем Новгороде, Казани, Крыму, Ставропольском крае и Москве. Вместе мы создали десятки работ, которые теперь радуют местных жителей и туристов. 
⠀
🤝Спасибо всем, кто был с нами, создавал и смотрел муралы фестиваля. Поздравляем и благодарим друзей проекта со всех стран мира и часовых поясов. Пусть в новом году вдохновение вас не покидает, погодные условия и трудности не пугают, а мир вокруг становится ярче!
⠀
🥳Искренне Ваша, команда «Культурного кода»! С наступающим Новым годом!

Мы собрали 5 миллионов рублей, которые будут направлены в пользу подопечных Благотворительного Фонда Константина Хабенского!
⠀
Благотворительный аукцион «Культурного кода» проходил в Москве в Государственном историческом музее. На нём были представлены 12 лотов, 11 из них включали в себя работы современных российских художников, еще одним лотом стало посещение Фонда драгоценных металлов Государственного исторического музея.

🎨Свои работы на мероприятии представили: @ilya_robe, @rustamqbic, @sasha_kupalyan, @fi_2k, @kirillkto, @ches_ches, @veisbrut_art, @dmitriy_levochkin, @vitalytsarenkov, @sshhozzy, @basil_lst, а также @fanstaknado, @vasyabasyo, дуэта @tweso1 и @nancattooing, @luchinin_art, @fork_one и @stepa_aifo.

Спасибо всем, кто принял участие в этом событии, вместе мы сделали для кого-то настоящее новогоднее чудо!

«Microworld»

Mystical jungles seeping into the fabric of the city. An expending natural ecosystem discovering new forms of diversity through the hand and vision of the artist.
With this work, I seek to draw attention to the small, almost imperceptible contribution of an individual in a time of global change.

“Microworld” first took root at the @urbanmorphogenesis festival in Balashikha, Moscow Region. Gratitude to everyone who took part!
✌️

—————————-

«Микромир»

Мистические джунгли, проникающие в пространство города. Разрастающаяся  природная экосистема, находящая новую форму разнообразия, через руку и мысль художника.

Своей работой я хочу уделить внимание маленькому, почти незаметному вкладу индивидуальной личности человека в период глобальных изменений.

А вы знали, что если в @2gis ввести «муралы Балашиха», то откроется слой со стрит-артом, где отмечены все адреса, авторы и описания работ? Очень удобно для самостоятельных зимних прогулок, пока нет экскурсий 😉

💐 «Пластилиновые цветы» — мурал московского художника Тимура FORK для фестиваля «Культурный код»! Этот яркий фасад стал самой большой работой, которая выполнена в уникальном стиле пластилинового реализма.

«Цветы в горшке»
символизируют семью, живущую в одном пространстве, дома.  Цветы нарисованы в авторском стиле - «пластилиновый реализм», что наглядно показывает, как мы творим свою жизнь, что мы способны сами «лепить» свою семью, дом и т.д.  Нам просто нужно сконцентрироваться и сфокусировать взгляд на действительно важных для нас вещах.
 Абстрактный фон дает нам неограниченные возможности для нашего воображения.  Каждый может создать то, что он хочет.

🔎 Найти фасад можно по адресу: Железнодорожный, Луговая, 16

Спецпроект от @pashaorez для фестиваля в Железнодорожном занимает 1200 кв.м и почетное место в его сердце, ведь в этом мурале он собрал две главных страсти своего детства: уличное искусство и футбол.

А рассмотреть работу получше можно в посте у нас в профиле 😉

#streetart #street_art #streetarteverywhere #mural #graffiti #urbanmorphogenesis #urban_art

Потрясающие кадры получаются, когда ты нашёл точку, с которой видно сразу несколько муралов! 

Мы специально размещаем фасады близко друг к другу, чтобы от одной работы можно было увидеть следующую. Так создаётся ощущение галереи и по городам фестиваля можно гулять как по настоящему музею уличного искусства под открытым небом.

Winter is coming, напоминают зимние сёрферы, которых создала @sasha_epshtein. Чем она вдохновилась на создание этого фасада для UMG, Саша рассказала в этом видео.

Кстати, в профиле есть полное описание идеи мурала, а также еще большей работ фестиваля 😉

🎲 «Взаимодействие» — новый мурал резидента UMG из Республики Татарстан @rustamqbic для нашего фестиваля в Балашихе! Творчество художника, вдохновленное жизнью, семьей, природой и книгами, несет в себе доступные каждому послания любви, знаний и духовности. 
 
«Наш мир строится на взаимопомощи и взаимовлиянии людей. Все мы разные, но дополняем друг друга, будь то в дружбе или в отношениях. В цветоведении есть такое понятие «дополнительные цвета» или «противоположные цвета». Это синий и оранжевый, желтый и фиолетовый, зелёный и красный. В палитре они совершенно противоположны, но в природе не существуют друг без друга. Рассуждения о том, что являясь уникальными и непохожими, мы уживаемся вместе, сосуществуем, привыкаем и уже не представляем жизнь без другого, я перенес в свою работу». 
 
🔎 Найти фасад можно по адресу: Железнодорожный, Пионерская, 21

One worth revisiting. 🌹

Some time ago, Emma Watson reflected on reaching a point in her life where she finally felt comfortable with her sense of self — and on learning to stay with uncertainty rather than trying to escape it.

“Sit with the discomfort. Don’t run away from it. Lean into it, take your time with it,” she shared.

And when it came to love, she turned to Osho:

“Love never becomes wise, and that is its wisdom.” 
Osho, Hammer on the Rock, 11

Love and relating are subjects Osho explores extensively throughout his books, questioning many of the ideas we inherit about how love and relationships are supposed to work.

Can you laugh when absolutely nothing funny is happening?

That’s where OSHO Laughter Meditation™ begins.

No joke. No story. No reason needed.

You start with a small giggle deep in the belly and allow it to grow. From laughter, the meditation moves into earthing — reconnecting with the ground beneath you — and finally into dance and celebration.

It’s one of the many OSHO Meditations you can experience during Global OSHO Meditation Day. 🌎

the more it continues underneath.

and what remains is not forced silence,
but something natural.

This might be one of the creepiest places you can tour in California! 🏰  Perched on a hill, Preston Castle looks like something out of a horror movie with towering brick walls, arched windows, and long, shadowy hallways. But this isn’t actually a castle! 😮 Built in 1894, it was the administration building for the Preston School of Industry, a reform school for boys that operated in Ione for decades. 🏫

Today you can tour the building—exploring the original rooms and hallways and learning what life was like for boys who lived and worked here. . Once the sun starts to set, the castle takes on a completely different feeling. 🔦 The nighttime flashlight tour takes you through the darkened building where empty rooms, winding staircases, and the castle’s shadows make it easy to see why this place has such an eerie reputation. 👻

Visitors have reported unexplained voices, shadows, and other strange experiences—the Foundation even offers dedicated paranormal investigations. 😱 Whether you believe in ghosts or not, by the time you leave, you might understand why so many people wonder what… or who… could still be lingering inside.

Did you know San Francisco is home to the world’s last manually operated cable car system? 🚎 The system, dating back to 1873, originated right here in San Francisco. 🌉 The cable cars were developed by Andrew Hallidie to help navigate the city’s steep hills. 🏛️

Unlike other forms of public transportation, cable cars don’t have their own motors and instead grip onto a continuously moving massive steel cable running beneath the street. The cable car operator, known as a gripman, controls the car by gripping and releasing the cable. Because the cable cars can’t turn themselves, they’re manually turned around on giant turntables at the end of the line—pretty cool to see in person. 😮

Cable cars eventually disappeared from other cities as more practical modes of public transportation replaced them. 🚌 San Francisco’s cable cars have stuck around in part because they’re so well-suited to the steep hills—but also because they’re iconic. You can still ride on this piece of history, with three cable car lines operating in San Francisco: Powell-Hyde, Powell-Mason, and California Street. Would you take a ride on these cable cars? 🎟️

Ready for a fright this October? 👻 We’ve got some chilling stories from California’s most haunted destinations. 🎃 If you’re brave enough, plan a trip to these spooky spots! 😱

🚢 Queen Mary (@TheQueenMary, @VisitLB): This retired ocean liner, permanently docked in Long Beach, has a history of reported hauntings, including screams from the boiler room and sightings of a “Lady in White.”
🏚️ Bodie State Historic Park (@BodieStateHistoricPark): This former gold-mining town has been preserved in a state of “arrested decay” and is known for its ghost stories and the “Curse of Bodie.”
🏰 Preston Castle (@PrestonCastleOfficial): Once a reform school for unruly youth and abandoned children, this castle has a history of paranormal activity. 
🏨 Hotel Del Coronado (@DelCoronado, @CoronadoVisitorCenter): Room 3327 of this Coronado Island hotel is at the center of California’s most famous ghost stories. Kate Morgan checked into the hotel in 1892 and never checked out. Reports of her ghost have persisted for decades. 
⭐ Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel (@TheHollywoodRoosevelt): This longtime Hollywood hangout is said to be haunted by Marilyn Monroe, who stayed in Room 1200. Guests have also reported hearing trumpet music said to be the spirit of Montgomery Clift, who stayed in Suite 928. 
🏛️ Winchester Mystery House (@WinchesterMysteryHouse): A door that leads to nowhere and a staircase that dead-ends into the ceiling? It’s said that widow Sarah Winchester designed her 160-room San Jose mansion to confuse the spirits she believed haunted her. 
😱 Moaning Caverns (@MoaningCaverns): Named for the wailing sound air once made passing through this cave, this Calaveras County wonder is also the site of some of America’s most ancient remains.

Akú “top radu” si už pri lezení dostal/a ty? 😁

Tieto rady v skutočnosti nie sú zlé, ale ak nevieš ako na to a nepoznáš kontext, ktorý sa za nimi skrýva, ťažko ich reálne využiješ v lezení. 

Náš kurz sa preto podrobne venuje témam, ktoré sa v zásade skrývajú aj v týchto radách:
👉 ako používať nohy, 
👉 ako pracovať s ťažiskom,
👉 čo s rukami a ako ich používať efektívne, 
👉 čo to znamená liezť technicky,
👉 aj ako liezť efektívnejšie. 

V kurze nájdeš nielen videolekcie, v ktorých si jednotlivé témy rozoberáme a ukazujeme na príkladoch, ale aj viac ako 50 cvičení, ktoré sú jednoduché, jasné a vieš si ich aj HNEĎ vyskúšať na stene. 

A aj cez ne vieš reálne uplatniť rady, ktoré ti v kurze dáme. 😊

Link na kurz nájdeš v našom BIO.

Staviteľsky sú takéto preteky vždy veľká výzva. Štartové pole je veľmi rôznorodé - výkonnostne aj rozmerovo. Mnohí majú natrénované a očakávajú rozradenie na základe sily alebo štandardných prvkov. Ja mám ale rád staviteľské prekvapenia, slepé uličky a pasce a technické prvky, ktoré preveria lezcov naozaj všestranne. Nie každý boulder nám vyšiel ako sme zamýšľali, ale myslím že ten mix nakoniec fungoval. Všetky boli leziteľné a zároveň žiadny nebol triviálny. Hlavným cieľom bolo postrážiť si dlháňov a nízke baby aby neboli výrazne zvýhodnení/znevýhodnení oproti bežnému priemeru a to si myslím že sa nám celkom podarilo.

Ďakujem môjmu staviteľskému tímu - Marcelovi, Filipovi a Svaťoušovi, fakt dobre sa mi s vami robilo a rád si to zopakujem.

From online forums to counselors to influencers, there’s a lot of noise about University of California admissions.

To help sort fact from fiction, here are some common myths about UC undergraduate admissions — and how things really work 👉

Myth #1: UC is impossible to get into. 

Reality: About 78% of California first-year applicants get into at least one UC campus. 

Myth: “There’s a ‘secret formula’ for getting accepted.”

Reality: Your whole application matters. Academics are the core, but no single piece guarantees admission.

Myth: “Getting into UC is basically a lottery.”

Reality: There is nothing random about UC admissions. Every application is thoroughly reviewed by real humans in a structured process with multiple checks.

Myth: “UC campuses decide together who gets in where.”

Reality: If you apply to multiple campuses, your application gets an independent review at each one. Admissions readers can’t even see what other UCs you applied to.

Myth: “Applying for financial aid will hurt my chances.”

Reality: It absolutely won’t. In fact, admissions teams can’t even access your financial aid application — the two processes are completely independent.

biography: The official hub for Classic Motown, celebrating music from 1959-1983

latestPosts.caption:
A little glitter just in time for the holidays ✨🎄

Celebrate the season with a limited edition gold glitter liquid-filled vinyl of A Motown Christmas. Featuring holiday favorites from The Temptations, The Supremes, Stevie Wonder, Smokey Robinson & The Miracles, The Jackson 5 and more, this fully playable pressing brings extra sparkle to a timeless holiday soundtrack. ❤️

Make your holidays golden. Pre-order at the link in bio.

Released in October 1983, Can’t Slow Down gave us timeless hits including “All Night Long (All Night),” “Hello,” “Stuck on You,” “Running with the Night” and “Penny Lover”, with all five singles reaching the Billboard Hot 100’s Top 10. 

The diamond-certified classic later took home the GRAMMY for Album of the Year. 🏆

Which song is your go-to? 🎶

A little wordplay. A whole lot of soul. 🎶

Released October 1967,  Smokey Robinson & the Miracles’ “I Second That Emotion”, is a classic that started with a shopping trip and climbed to No. 1 on the R&B chart.

Released 57 years ago, “I Want You Back” introduced the Jackson 5 to Motown, and became the first of their history-making four consecutive No. 1 hits.

Which fact surprised you most? 👇🏾

#Jackson5 #IWantYouBack #Motown

Before The Supremes became Motown superstars, they put their own stamp on Smokey Robinson’s “Who’s Lovin’ You.” Their rendition was released as the B-side to “Buttered Popcorn” and later appeared on the group’s debut album, Meet The Supremes.

Originally written and recorded by Smokey Robinson and The Miracles in 1960, the song would become a Motown favorite, inspiring recordings by The Temptations, Brenda Holloway and, later, the Jackson 5.
Celebrating 50 years of ‘Songs In The Key Of Life’ 💚

Songs in the Key of Life – The EP continues the story of one of the greatest albums of all time. 

Curated by Stevie Wonder, the four previously unreleased recordings were recently mixed by original recording and mixing engineers John Fischbach and Gary O Adante. Released this morning at exactly 4:54 a.m. PT, the timing nods to a late-night studio session when Nathan Watts, Stevie’s longtime bassist, exclaimed, “Fo’FiftyFo’!” The phrase became an inside joke for anyone in Stevie’s circle. Now, that hour opens a new chapter, bringing four unheard recordings to the world.

Did you know one of Motown’s biggest hits was almost left on an album shelf? 🎪👇 Today marks the anniversary of Smokey Robinson & The Miracles’ iconic track, “The Tears of a Clown”. To celebrate, check out some mind-blowing facts you might not know about this legendary song 🎶

A little nostalgia, a whole lot of groove. 🎹✨
Stevie Wonder turned memories of growing up into one of the most unforgettable tracks on Songs in the Key of Life. Nearly 50 years later, “I Wish” still has us moving from the very first note. 
Press play for a few fun facts behind the Motown classic. 🎶

The Motown family mourns the passing of a true icon, Rosalind Ashford, who has passed away at the age of 83. 🤍🕊️

As an original founding member of Martha and the Vandellas, Rosalind’s vocal talent helped define the golden era of the Motown sound. From the soul-stirring energy of “Heat Wave” and “Dancing in the Street” to timeless classics like “Jimmy Mack” and “Nowhere to Run,” her harmonies served as the soundtrack to a generation.

Inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 1995, Rosalind’s contribution to American music and Motown history will never be forgotten. Rest in power, Rosalind. Thank you for the music. ✨

60 years ago today, @supremesmusic reached the final day of their two-week run at No. 1 on the US Billboard Hot 100 with their iconic hit “You Can’t Hurry Love”! 💗 Still a classic all these years later. Is this one still on your playlist? 🎵

The Temptations put their own spin on a Stevie Wonder classic. 🎶✨
Watch the group take on “Signed, Sealed, Delivered (I’m Yours)” on The Ed Sullivan Show, bringing those unmistakable Temptations harmonies to the hit Stevie first made famous.

Algarve Surf Clube started in 1996.
We’re turning 30, and this is our way of celebrating: bringing culture and community to Sagres, and thanking the ocean for everything it has given us so far. 🌊
Sagres Sessions · Oct 30 – Nov 1

Com uma costa virada a sul e outra a oeste, Sagres tem quase sempre um sítio onde a onda entra. Mas aqui o mar não se domina: respeita-se. O vento muda, a maré sobe, o Atlântico decide. Quem vive em Sagres aprende isso cedo.
O Sagres Sessions nasce desta mistura. Não é só um campeonato nem só um festival. É um encontro entre quem vive do mar e quem vive para ele. Surf, arte, música e mercado, lado a lado, numa vila que abre as portas durante três dias.

📷 @joaocabritasilva

biography: Welcome to the City of Melbourne’s official account. Our inbox isn’t monitored.

latestPosts.caption:
The Golden Elm on Punt Road needs your vote 🌳 📧 
 
There’s a reason this tree has received more emails than any other: for almost 90 years, it’s kept generations of Melburnians company on their daily commute. 

If this much-loved icon holds a special place in your heart, show it some love – and celebrate the trees that make Melbourne the Garden City. 
 
Click the link in our bio to help make our Golden Elm Victorian Tree of the Year 🔗

Ever wonder why this arts venue is called the Meat Market? 🤔🥩
 
The heritage building has worn many hats over the years – from the place that Melburnians bought their meat, to a carpark and a craft market. Today, it's one of our most unique arts venue for hire.
 
With Melbourne Fringe wrapping up this weekend, see if you can spot signs of the building's early days while you're visiting for a show.

One year down, plenty more laps to go 🏊

In just 12 months, the Kensington Community Aquatic and Recreation Centre has welcomed 500,000 visitors, become home to 20 sporting groups, helped 140+ people learn to swim for free, and delivered more than 5,000 group fitness classes.

Not a bad rap sheet before they've even turned 1.

Join us this Saturday as we celebrate an incredible first year of the Kensington Community Aquatic and Recreation Centre with free activities, fitness classes, music, games and more. 

Details via link in bio. See you at Kenny Rec!

Big wheels keep on turning 🎡

We are spinning around at the news that Melbourne Star is turning once again.

After more than five years sitting idle, this Docklands diva is now open to passengers, offering 120-metre-high stellar views of Melbourne’s stunning skyline and helping drive thousands of visitors to the area.

Melburnians never gave up on @melbournestarwheel, and now the highest observation wheel in the Southern Hemisphere is shining over @thedistrictdocklands once again ✨

Melbourne precincts have their own personalities, and we’ve got the data to prove it 🛍️
 
The latest Melbourne Economy Snapshot is here, alongside our very first Business Precinct Snapshots – uncovering local insights into spending, visitation and customer behaviour across our 10 business precincts.
 
Flick through to see where you fit and discover what makes each neighbourhood unique.
 
Explore the full snapshots via our link in bio 🔗

Great cities don’t just happen 🏙️ 

As Melbourne grows, we need fresh ideas to keep our city liveable, connected and creative – while protecting what makes it special.

Next week, local and global leaders will come together at Melbourne Assembly to share ideas, challenge thinking and help shape Melbourne’s future.

Swipe to learn more and hit the link in our bio to join the conversation 🔗

Who knew reporting an issue could be this easy? 🤯📱

From unwanted graffiti to dumped rubbish, the Snap Send Solve app makes it easy to report issues around the city.

Simply snap a photo, confirm the location and send it through. Your report gets directed to the right teams so we can solve the issue – faster.

Thanks for alerting us to issues to help keep Melbourne clean, safe and welcoming.

Click on the link in our bio to learn more 🔗

Celebrate the new world-class lan Potter State Theatre at this fun free weekend in Melb! Head down and find food trucks, pop-up roving performers, laser installations, family-friendly entertainment and heaps more. Visit @artscentremelbourne for details 😎 

📍 Housewarming, lan Potter State Theatre, Arts Centre Melbourne
🗓️ 9-11 Oct
ℹ️ Limited free tickets available for free performances each day 

#Melbourne #WhatsOnMelbourne

Big things are coming to Boyd Community Hub! 

We're delivering the spaces our Southbank residents have been asking for, including the area's first Community Hall and other facility upgrades for this growing neighbourhood. 

With works set to begin in mid-2027, this will be the final phase of our Boyd precinct transformation – with the new Southbank Library opening soon. 

Learn more about this project via our link in bio 🔗

Who’s up for a treasure hunt? 🌱    Uncover hidden plants across Melbourne as you follow the Growing Place trail, scanning colourful pavement stickers to bring local species to life through augmented reality.     Hint: Start your search at the State Library and see where the trail takes you. 
 
Learn more and plan your adventure via our link in bio 🔗

Drawing a new line for Melbourne’s walls 🎨 

Our draft Graffiti Management Policy aims to tackle graffiti while still supporting street art. 

We want to hear what you think – from what should count as art to new mural locations and more. 

Share your feedback via our link in bio 🔗

Melbourne’s favourite reality show is back 🪺
 
The Collins Street peregrine falcons have just welcomed their biggest brood yet, with all the action live-streamed 24/7.
 
But there’s a challenging twist this season, with the rise of bird flu posing a threat to wild bird populations. 
 
Tune in and learn how you can help protect our feathered friends via our link in bio 🔗

🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

A barbecue hangulat és a pizza tökéletes találkozása! 🍕🇺🇸🔥

A mi Pulled Pork pizzánkon a lassan sült, omlós tépett disznóhús játssza a főszerepet. Gazdag paradicsomos alapra helyezzük, majd lágy mozzarellával, ropogós baconnel és édeskés lilahagymával pakoljuk meg, hogy minden falat egy igazi ízorgia legyen. 🤤

Ha egy igazán tartalmas, füstös-szaftos pizzára vágysz, megtaláltad a kedvencedet!

———————————————————-

Dokonalé spojenie barbecue atmosféry a skvelej pizze! 🍕🇺🇸🔥

Na našej pizze Pulled Pork hrá hlavnú rolu pomaly pečené, jemné trhané bravčové mäso. Dávame ho na bohatý paradajkový základ a dopĺňame jemnou mozzarellou, chrumkavou slaninou (bacon) a sladkastou červenou cibuľou, aby bol každý kúsok skutočným chuťovým zážitkom. 🤤

Ak túžite po naozaj sýtej, dymovo-šťavnatej pizze, práve ste našli svojho favorita!

📞 0918 232 215
🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

Extra Cordon Bleu ✌️

A klasszikus kedvenc, ami most szintet lépett! 🐔🔥

Gondoltuk egyet, és teljesen újragondoltuk a hagyományos Cordon Bleu-t. A szaftos csirkemellet ezúttal ropogós baconnel és karakteres füstölt sajttal töltöttük meg, majd egy extra roppanós Corn Flakes (kukoricapehely) bundába öltöztettük. Köretként édesburgonyát kínálunk mellé. 🤤🍠

Kívül elképesztően ropogós, belül fenségesen szaftos és füstös – ezt egyszerűen ki kell próbálnod!

—————————————————————

Klasický favorit v novom, modernom šate! 🐔🔥

Rozhodli sme sa premeniť tradičné Cordon Bleu na skutočný gastronomický zážitok. Šťavnaté kuracie prsia sme naplnili chrumkavou slaninou (bacon) a výrazným údeným syrom, a následne sme ich obalili v extra chrumkavej Corn Flakes (kukuričné lupienky) kruste. Ako prílohu k nemu podávame sladké zemiaky (bataty). 🤤🍠

Zvonku neskutočne chrumkavé, vnútri dokonale šťavnaté a dymové – toto jednoducho musíte ochutnať!

📞 0918 232 215
🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

A megunhatatlan aranyhármas, ami nélkül nincs étlap! 🧀🍟

Van, hogy a legegyszerűbb dolgok a legfinomabbak. Kívül ropogós, belül ellenállhatatlanul nyúlós rántott sajt, mellé aranybarna, forró hasábburgonya és a hűsítő, krémes tartármártás. Egy igazi nosztalgikus kedvenc, ami felnőttnek és gyereknek egyaránt mosolyt csal az arcára! 😍

Ebédre vagy vacsorára? Bármikor jöhet!

————————————————————-

Nezameniteľné trio, ktoré nesmie chýbať na žiadnom jedálnom lístku! 🧀🍟

Niekedy sú tie najjednoduchšie veci tie najlepšie. Vonku chrumkavý, vnútri neodolateľne ťahavý vyprážaný syr, k tomu zlatisté, horúce hranolky a osviežujúca, krémová tatárska omáčka. Skutočná nostalgická klasika, ktorá vyčarí úsmev na tvári dospelým aj deťom! 😍

Na obed alebo na večeru? S radosťou kedykoľvek!

📞 0918 232 215
🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

A tengerparti ízek szerelmeseinek! 🐟🍋🍕

A mi Tonno pizzánk egy igazi mediterrán klasszikus. A szaftos tonhaldarabok, a karakteres lilahagyma és a prémium olívabogyók találkozása a lágyan olvadó sajttal egy falatnyi nyarat varázsol a tányérodra. Friss, intenzív és elképesztően finom! 

Te kóstoltad már ezt a zseniális kombinációt?

——————————————————————

Pre milovníkov prímorských chutí! 🐟🍋🍕

Naša pizza Tonno je skutočnou stredomorskou klasikou. Spojenie šťavnatých kúskov tuniaka, výraznej červenej cibule a prémiových olív s jemne sa rozplývajúcim syrom vyčaruje na vašom tanieri kúsok leta. Svieža, intenzívna a neskutočne chutná! 

Už ste vyskúšali túto geniálnu kombináciu?

📞 0918 232 215
🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

A verhetetlen négyes, amit mindenki imád! 🍕🌽🍄

Van, amikor a klasszikus ízek esnek a legjobban. A mi pizzánkon a szaftos sonka, a friss gomba és az édes kukorica találkozik a lágyan olvadó, aranybarnára sült sajttal. Egy igazi közönségkedvenc, amivel egyszerűen nem lehet melléfogni! 

Kérd ebédre vagy egy családi moziestre! 🎬

—————————————————————-

Neporaziteľná štvorka, ktorú miluje každý! 🍕🌽🍄

Sú chvíle, kedy klasické chute padnú najlepšie. Na našej pizze sa spája šťavnatá šunka, čerstvé šampiňóny a sladká kukurica s jemne sa rozplývajúcim, do zlatista upečeným syrom. Skutočný favorit, s ktorým nikdy nešliapnete vedľa! 

Dajte si ju na obed alebo k rodinnému filmovému večeru! 🎬

📞 0918 232 215
🌐 www.pizzaking.sk

latestPosts.caption:
“Naturari idatzitako maitasun gutun erromantikoa"

BBK Mendi Film Bilbao Bizkaiaren 19. edizioak badu irudi nagusia: Quantum Cave Chronicles 1 izeneko argazkia da, Lei Bao argazkilariak Txinako Guangxi eskualdeko tiankeng baten barruan ateratako irudia.
Donostiako Club Vasco de Camping Elkarteak antolatutako CVCEPHOTO mendi jarduerei buruzko argazki lehiaketan saritua izan da. 
800 euroko diru-saria irabazi du eta aurtengo Mendi Film zinemaldiaren irudia izango da.
...
"Una romántica carta de amor a la Naturaleza"

La 19ª edición del BBK Mendi Film Bilbao Bizkaia, que se celebrará del 4 al 13 de diciembre de 2026, presenta su imagen principal: Quantum Cave Chronicles 1, una fotografía tomada por Lei Bao en el interior de un tiankeng en la región de Guangxi, China.
Ha sido premiada en el concurso de fotografía de actividad de montaña CVCEPHOTO, organizado por el Club Vasco de Camping Elkartea de San Sebastián. 
Ha obtenido un premio en metálico de 800 euros y será la imagen oficial del Mendi Film de este año.
...
"Romantic love letter to the land"

The 19th edition of BBK Mendi Film Bilbao Bizkaia, to be held from December 4 to 13, 2026, presents its main image: Quantum Cave Chronicles 1, a photograph taken by Lei Bao inside a tiankeng in the Guangxi autonomous region of China.
It won in the BBK Mendi Film Bilbao Bizkaia Poster category of the CVCEPHOTO mountain activity photography contest, organized by the Club Vasco de Camping Elkartea. 
It received a cash prize of 800 euros and will be the official image of this year's Mendi Film festival.

"SERIOUSLY COMMITTED TO THE SHARP END"
@kadekrichko kazetari estatubatuarrak Adventure Journal aldizkarian artikulua idatzi du ATXARTEko eskalada eremu mitikoari erasan zien harrobi-lanak geldiarazteko 90. hamarkadan eman zen protesta mugimenduak inspiratuta.
Guillermo "Willy" Bañales, Jabi Berasaluze, Edu Gomez... elkarrizketatuz sortu du orduko mugimendu baketsu eta eraginkor hari buruzko kontakizuna.
Banff Centre Mountain Film Festival-eko Mendiko Liburu Lehiaketan, artikuluen atalean, finalista izendatu dute.
Urri erdialdera emango dute irabazleen berri.
Edonola ere, ZORIONAK Kade!
...
American journalist Kade Krichko has written an article for *Adventure Journal* inspired by the protest movement that took place at the ATXARTE climbing paradise in the 1990s.
He crafted the story of that peaceful yet effective movement againts the mines by interviewing figures such as Guillermo "Willy" Bañales, Jabi Berasaluze, and Edu Gomez.
The piece has been named a finalist in the Mountain Article category of the @banffmountainfestival Mountain Book Competition.
The winners will be announced in mid-October.
Congratulations, Kade!
...
El periodista estadounidense Kade Krichko ha escrito un artículo para la revista Adventure Journal inspirado en el movimiento de protesta que tuvo lugar en ATXARTE, en los años 90, enfrentándose a la cantera que pasó a desfigurar la zona.
Ha escrito una historia sobre aquel pacífico y efectivo movimiento entrevistando a Guillermo "Willy" Bañales, Jabi Berasaluze y Edu Gómez, entre otros.
El prestigioso Concurso de Libros de Montaña del Festival de Cine de Montaña de Banff lo ha seleccionado como finalista en la sección de artículos de montaña.
Las obras ganadoras se anunciarán a mediados de octubre.
¡FELICIDADES Kade!
.

💥 Two days left for attending the 7th edition of the Mendi Film Bizkaia Ternua Beka! 

A grant promoted by Mendi Film, Ternua and the Basque Language, Culture and Sports Ministry of the Bizkaia Regional Government, aimed at the creation of documentary film projects that seek to promote mountain culture through audiovisual means.

Mountain culture is understood from multiple perspectives, whether sporting, cultural or social, or through projects related to sustainability, ecology, and/or climate change. 

👉 Priority will be given to young filmmakers, projects filmed wholly or partly within the historical territory of Bizkaia, and those with a local-global character. 

👉 The grant consists of a financial contribution of €10,000 and a support programme, led by the creative producer Itziar García Zubiri, to develop the selected project.

🌟 Officially announcing 
🌲 Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival 
🌱August 6-9, 2026
⛺️Meeks Bay Resort & Campground 
📣 Registration is officially open with our SUPER early bird special discount tickets link in bio. 

Join us for another magical weekend on this beautiful sacred land with Yoga, AcroYoga, Nature Hikes, Meditation, Dance, Slackline, lakeside camping, Educational Talks with incredibly talented wellness practitioners from our local and extended community!

Food by Mountain Lotus Provisions 
Tipi’s by @chakravillage 
Shade by @theshadeshifters 
Onsite massage & bodywork by @gravitybodywork @viveelizabethcurran & amdbodywork

More good vibes from the Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival 💕💕. Love my community! Thanks to everyone that made it a success! @wellnessplaygroundretreats @greenearthlover @mountainlotusprovisions @newmoonnaturalfoods #wellnessplayground

I’m still feeling the glow from all the wonderful experiences I enjoyed at the Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival at Meeks Bay. So many great conversations and dances with old friends along side meeting wonderful new friends. I’m honored to have been one of the teachers invited to share my gifts. We are blessed to have so many amazing people in this Truckee Tahoe community. Celebrating playfulness and the beauty of the Tahoe waters and land. Thanks @greenearthlover and @wellnessplaygroundretreats for all your hard work to create this time and space to engage in conscious community. 💕🕺🏔️

Still vibrating with pure gratitude after an unforgettable 4 days at the Wellness Playground Retreat.🌀✨️ 

We started our days with sunrise yoga 🧘‍♀️ paddleboarding and Qigong, learned transformative breathwork, journeyed within 👁 and pushed past fears. We grooved, laughed and danced like no one was watching💃🏼. We watched the stars 🌌 and jumped into the clear waters of Tahoe 🌊

This experieence reminded me of the incredible healing power of human connection and kindness 🫂 Every interaction was a beautiful reminder of how good it feels to be seen, supported, and loved just as you are. I left with full heart and a quiet soul 🤍

Huge love to Laura, Anastasia, and every beautiful soul who shared their magic with me this weekend. You are my people. 🫶✨

#WellnessPlayground

A little glimpse into Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival with @wellnessplaygroundretreats 
I reallllly wish I took more photos / vids, was way too busy being fully in the moment! 

It was an incredible honor and pleasure to have facilitated and participated in this amazing weekend experience. We were tucked away in our own paradise at Meeks Bay on the West Shore of Lake Tahoe, with our own private beach, food truck @mountainlotusprovisions, yoga, dance and wellness classes all day, live music and DJ sets, beautiful mermaids, swimming, paddle boarding, camping, and most importantly a beautiful community of incredible people that felt like family even though many of them I had just met for the first time. I’m continually reminded of how important it is to gather and be in community, connecting, playing, being, sharing. This is the medicine of our times. Keep showing up, we need you! 

Thank you @coopdaloopthedj for co-creating ALCHEMIZE with me, for everyone who showed up courageously to this class to co-create the magical experience we had. It’s not everyday that you’re guided into a rage ritual. ALCHEMIZE asks those who show up to step out of their comfort zone and face uncomfortable parts of ourselves, so I’m truly grateful to everyone who shows up and is willing and open 😊🔥

It was such a treat being on the water on a paddling adventure with @thatmountaingirl on Friday and @powerrestoremethod and @inspiredlifeayurveda on Sunday, taking an amazing yoga class with @shari.w.beard, chilling the F out in @wildharmonyhealth sound bath next to my dear sister @marissa.mignone.doula , reconnecting with old friends, making new connections, dancing in the water with a crew of badass babes, and finishing with a sweet closing circle that felt like a big warm hug. 

A huge shout out to @greenearthlover and @atouchofjoy for the vision and creation of this incredible event and all the hearts and hands that played a role in making it come alive. It truly takes a village. 

My heart is full & my soul is lit!
🫶 ❤️‍🔥✨🌊 🧜‍♀️ 🧘🏻‍♀️🌮🌅 🎶👙💃🏻⛰️🦎🐿️ 🩵

دیدار با حضرت آیت الله حسینی همدانی، نماینده ولی فقیه در استان البرز و امام جمعه کرج به همراه دیگر مسئولان و مدیران ورزش و جوانان استان البرز به مناسبت هفته تربیت بدنی

یکشنبه بیست و ششم مهرماه ۱۴۰۵
مراسم اختتامیه جشنواره گرامیداشت روز و هفته شهرستان کرج، سالن شهیدان نژاد فلاح، دوشنبه بیستم مهرماه ۱۴۰۵

تجلیل و تقدیر از بیت مکرم ابا الشهید، حضرت آیت الله مرحوم محمد باقر قدوسی (ره) ، امام جمعه سابق کرج،فردیس، مشکین دشت و محمدشهر و خانواده شهید بین الحرمین حجت الاسلام حسین قدوسی و دیدار با فرزندان ایشان، حجت الاسلام قدوسی که مسئولیت امام جمعه شهر مشکین دشت را نیز بر عهده دارند .
از حضرت آیت الله قدوسی به عنوان پدر معنوی شهر مشکین دشت یاد میشود. او در سال ۱۳۹۹ به فرزند شهیدش پیوست. 
به رسم یادبود لوح تقدیری خدمت بیت مکرم ایشان از طرف کمیسیون مبارزه با قاچاق کالا و ارز استان البرز اهدا گردید.

مهرماه ۱۴۰۵، مشکین دشت

دیروز، در ادامه سرکشی از خانواده معظم شهدا و ایثارگران، توفیق حاصل شد تا در معیت برادر عزیز و بزرگوارم، جناب آقای پاشازاده، ریاست محترم اداره بنیاد شهید منطقه دو شهرستان کرج و برادر بسیجی، جانباز سرافراز و خادم‌الشهدا، حاج حشمت‌الله فروغی، به دیدار جانباز سرافراز اعصاب و روان، یادگار هشت سال دفاع مقدس، جناب آقای رمضانعلی بیات در عباس آباد محمد شهر برویم.

وقتی بر بالین این سروِ ایستاده اما خسته حاضر شدیم، بغض در گلویم گره خورد. برادر عزیزمان، آقای بیات، که روزگاری در میدان‌های نبرد با دشمنِ بعثی، شیرمردانه ایستاده بود، امروز بر اثر جراحات ناشی از جانبازی و ترکش‌های به یادگار مانده، و پس از تحمل سکته‌های سنگین مغزی و قلبی، در سکوتی عمیق فرو رفته است. او که توانایی صحبت، بلع، حرکت و راه رفتن را از دست داده و در شرایطی بسیار سخت و طاقت‌فرسا، ۲۴ ساعت شبانه‌روز را در بستر بیماری و مراقبت های ویژه و دستگاه حیات سپری می‌کند، حقیقتاً «شهیدِ زنده» و اسوهٔ صبر است.

اما دردناک‌تر و در عین حال درس‌آموزتر از وضعیتِ پدر، نگاه کردن به فرزند او بود؛ فرزندی که خود با وجود معلولیت ذهنی، با اراده‌ای بزرگ، تمام توانش را می‌گذارد تا مرهمی باشد بر آلام پدر و مادرش. دیدن این صحنه، هر دلی را به لرزه در می‌آورد؛ عشقی که در این خانه، فراتر از توانِ جسمی جاری است.

در این دیدار، مفتخر بودم که به نمایندگی از دبیر محترم کمیسیون مبارزه با قاچاق کالا و ارز استان البرز، و به نیابت از استاندار عزیز، مردمی و ریاست محترم کمیسیون، و همچنین «قرارگاه مردمی اقتصاد مقاومتی استان البرز»، هدیه‌ای ناچیز و لوح تقدیری را به خانوادهٔ فداکار و زحمتکش این جانباز بزرگوار تقدیم کنیم.

باور قلبی‌مان این است که این دیدارها، نه یک امر ساده، بلکه «تکلیفِ ایمانی» و «توفیقِ الهی» است. ما نیامده بودیم که چیزی بدهیم؛ ما آمده بودیم که درسِ عشق و استقامت بگیریم. شرمندهٔ این خانواده‌ایم که با وجود همهٔ رنج‌ها و سختی‌ها، همچنان با افتخار ایستاده‌اند. امیدوارم خداوند به برکتِ نفسِ این جانبازِ عزیز و دعایِ خانوادهٔ صبورش، عاقبتِ همهٔ ما را ختم به خیر کند.

ای کاش بدانیم که امنیت و آرامش امروزمان، مدیون همین سکوت‌ها و همین دردهای پنهانی است. امیدوارم در پیشگاه خداوند و شهدا، شرمندهٔ این بزرگان نباشیم.

خدمتگزار شما

روز دوشنبه هفتم مهرماه در آخرین روز از هفته دفاع مقدس، در راستای اجرای توصیه رهبر معظم انقلاب، توفیقی والا و بسیار ارزشمند به بنده حقیر دست داد تا به نمایندگی از برادر عزیزم دکتر عبدالله دارایی، مدیرکل محترم مبارزه با قاچاق کالا و ارز استان البرز و همچنین به نیابت از استاندار عزیز و مردمی و رئیس کمیسیون مبارزه با قاچاق کالا و ارز استان البرز، و همراهی جمعی از معتمدین محله اسلام آباد شهر کرج  لوح تقدیر و هدایایی را از طرف کمیسیون و قرارگاه مردمی اقتصاد مقاومتی استان البرز به خانواده شهید والامقام و مفقود الاثر جنگ تحمیلی هشت ساله شهید مسعود حسنی اهدا کنم . شاید این کوچک‌ترین وظیفه هر انسان، فارغ از هر جایگاه و مسئولیتی هست که باید در قبال شهدا انجام پذیرد. خداوندا از ما قبول فرما و توفیق شهادت را به شرط لیاقت بر ما و همه مشتاقانش ارزانی دار.

برگشتن به ریشه‌ها، همیشه معنای تازه‌ای دارد… 🌱

چند ماه قبل در دانشگاه آزاد اسلامی واحد کرج، جایی که اولین قدم‌های خودباوری‌ام را در گذشته های نه چندان دور به عنوان یک دانشجو برداشتم، با جمعی از دوستان و فعالان دانشجویی هم‌کلام شدم. اما این بار نه فقط برای یادگیری، بلکه برای طرح یک چالش بزرگ.

مطرح کردم که چرا نباید اجازه داد ایده‌های خلاقانه دانشجویان در اتاق‌های درس بماند؟ ما نیاز داریم این انرژی را در قالب شبکه‌های جهادی دانشجویی، برای حل مسائل استان به کار بگیریم. به‌ویژه در نبرد با قاچاق کالا و ارز که نیازمند نگاهی نو، تکنولوژیک و هوشمندانه است.

قدرت تغییر در دستان جوانانی جهادگر است که هم «دانش» دارند و هم «ایمان» به توانمندی خودشان. 💪🇮🇷 انشاالله با تلاش فراوان، جلسات کارگروه های ویژه دانشجویان در کمیسیون مبارزه با قاچاق کالا و ارز استان البرز برگزار خواهد شد و از نظرات دانشجویان دغدغه مند در این مبارزه حیاتی و بسیار مهم در عرصه امنیت اقتصادی استفاده خواهد شد.

در میان مردم، برای مردم

✍️ محمد پارسا افشاری 

گاهی بهترین کلاس درس، نه یک سالن همایش است و نه یک اتاق جلسه؛ بلکه واگن‌های متروست...

به عنوان یک شهروند، بخش قابل توجهی از رفت‌وآمدهای روزانه‌ام به تهران را با مترو انجام می‌دهم. هر روز در کنار مردمی می‌ایستم که هر کدام داستانی برای گفتن دارند؛ کارگری که از سپیده‌دم راهی کار شده، دانشجویی که برای ساختن آینده تلاش می‌کند، مادری که دست فرزندش را محکم گرفته و سالمندی که آرام و بی‌صدا مسیرش را طی می‌کند.

مترو برای من فقط یک وسیله حمل‌ونقل نیست؛ آیینه‌ای از زندگی مردم است. جایی که می‌توان بی‌واسطه دغدغه‌ها، امیدها، لبخندها و حتی خستگی‌های جامعه را دید و لمس کرد.

شاید همین تجربه‌های روزانه است که بیش از هر چیز، معنای واقعی خدمت را برایم یادآوری می‌کند. توفیقی که امروز در سنگر ارتباطات اجتماعی و روابط عمومی و همچنین مدیریت در حوزه ورزش نصیبم شده، تنها زمانی ارزشمند است که صدای مردم را بشنود، مسائلشان را درک کند و با صداقت، پلی میان مردم و مسئولان باشد.

روابط عمومی، اگر از متن جامعه فاصله بگیرد، رسالت خود را فراموش کرده است. باور دارم هر قدمی که در کنار مردم برداشته شود، هر گفت‌وگویی که از دل جامعه شنیده شود و هر تجربه‌ای که در میان همین واگن‌های مترو شکل بگیرد، می‌تواند چراغ راه تصمیم‌های بهتر و خدمت مؤثرتر باشد.

با آرزوی موفقیت برای همه عزیزان به ویژه آقای محرم زاده عزیز، ریاست محترم هیات شطرنج شهرستان فردیس

تشکر از سرکار خانم شهبازی و همسر گرانقدرشان بابت دعوت و برگزاری مسابقات پس از ماه ها در شهر کرج .

🔴 نایب رئیس آقایان هیات شطرنج استان البرز در گفتگو با خبرگزاری پانا مطرح کرد؛

Afterpay Available

From the late 90s to the early 2000s was a major turning point for Tasmanian skateboarding.  Tasmanian skaters were starting to make an impact on a national level, there were more tours happening and skateboarding was gaining popularity.

During this stage the Domain Ramp was one of the few skate facilities in Hobart, so the streets were where it was at and luckily skatestoppers weren’t a thing then!

Video cameras were also becoming cheaper and easier to obtain so more people were starting to film.  Here’s a redux of some of the spots and crew that were killing it at the stage filmed by @ewingram and Jai Critchley.

Little did we know how much skateboarding would change once Hobart “EC” skatepark was built… - Duncan

Ben un terzo degli studenti delle superiori (il 33%) sta partecipando attivamente alle proteste studentesche di questi giorni. A tracciare i confini dell'adesione attiva alle istanze giovanili emerse in questo “autunno caldo” della scuola (e non solo) è un sondaggio effettuato da Skuola.net su un campione di 1.500 alunni proprio delle classi superiori.⁠
⁠
Entrando nel dettaglio delle adesioni, circa 1 su 10 ha dichiarato di prendere o di aver preso parte a un'occupazione vera e propria nel proprio istituto, mentre grossomodo un quarto (24%) ha partecipato ad autogestioni, scioperi, manifestazioni o sit-in.⁠
⁠
Ma l'impatto del fenomeno è ancora più vasto: se si sommano a questi anche coloro che non hanno animato in prima persona le proteste ma vivono in istituti mobilitati (26%), si scopre che ben 6 su 10 – precisamente il 59% – sono entrati a stretto contatto con qualche forma di dissenso e quasi altrettanti (56%) condividono abbastanza, se non completamente, i motivi delle manifestazioni.⁠
⁠

Con la ripresa delle lezioni universitarie, le tende degli studenti sono tornate ad occupare Piazza Montecitorio e i principali atenei italiani, da Milano a Lecce, da Bologna a Torino, da Genova a Pavia. L’Unione degli Universitari lancia la mobilitazione “Cara Italia, quanto ci costi?” riportando al centro del dibattito il peso dell’inflazione, l’emergenza abitativa e la gestione del diritto allo studio.⁠
⁠
Per una famiglia che ha un figlio fuori sede, il solo costo di una stanza ha raggiunto livelli molto esosi: dai 669 euro di Milano, ai 674 euro di Roma e 606 euro di Bologna. Si spende meno a Napoli con 488 euro e a Genova dove in media la stanza singola costa 430 euro.⁠
⁠
La situazione non è da meno se si varcano i confini nazionali. Secondo le rilevazioni della piattaforma HousingAnywhere tra le città con i canoni più contenuti figurano Budapest (380 euro), Atene (415 euro) e Valencia (450 euro), mentre gli affitti più elevati si registrano ad Amsterdam (1.000 euro), Rotterdam (884 euro), Parigi (875 euro), Barcellona (690 euro), Berlino e Bruxelles (650 euro).⁠
⁠
Attenzione poi al vero budget, perché i costi non si non si fermano al solo affitto della stanza: a questi oneri vanno aggiunti quelli per le utenze (luce, gas, talvolta anche per la connessione internet), quelli per il vitto, per i mezzi pubblici e dulcis in fundo quelli per l’università. Insomma, a tre anni dalle prime tendopoli che abbiamo visto nelle sedi universitarie il caro affitti è sempre più insostenibile.⁠
⁠

Dal 1944 a oggi, il ruolo del dollaro e gli equilibri geopolitici ed economici globali sono profondamente cambiati. Ma oggi abbiamo davvero la necessità di stabilire un nuovo assetto monetario per garantire una futura prosperità? 

📍Ne parliamo martedì 27 ottobre alle 18:00 in una cornice d'eccezione: il Museo Bagatti Valsecchi, nel cuore di Milano. 

Insieme a Giovanni Tria e Angelo Federico Arcelli, autori di "Una nuova Bretton Woods per il XXI secolo", proveremo a mettere sul tavolo le coordinate per capire in che direzione sta andando il futuro degli scambi globali. 
A guidare il confronto ci sarà il Direttore de Il Sole 24 Ore, Fabio Tamburini. 

L'ingresso è libero fino a esaurimento posti.

Difficile dire a cosa somiglia la nuova Ferrari Hypersail. È nera o quasi come molte barche a vela da regata, dove il carbonio domina. Ha del giallo, come tante auto Ferrari. È grande per, essere uno di quegli oggetti che più che stare in acqua ci volano sopra. Il team l’ha finalmente mostrata, fotografata. È ancora dentro il cantiere di Pisa dove è stata costruita ma scafo e coperta sono completi, chiusi. E girandole attorno si può intuire cosa sarà vederla andare per mare, con l’equipaggio chiuso dentro, dietro le solide porte stagne con l’acqua che passa attorno. ⁠
⁠
L’obiettivo finale è il record attorno al mondo Jules Verne, da fare in meno di 40 giorni, la metà di quanto allo scrittore sembrava già impossibile. Prima molti allenamenti in Atlantico per renderla affidabile e sicura. Una delle prime cose, dopo il varo previsto a fine marzo e l’apertura della base a Livorno all’interno dei cantieri Azimut Benetti, saranno le prove al traino senza vele per verificare le strutture e la risposta dei sistemi di controllo.⁠
⁠
Ma Ferrari Hypersail non è solo un oggetto creato per battere i record. Dimensioni ed esigenze sono così diverse da quelle di altre barche che è nuovo anche il metodo di progetto. Anche solo il fatto che sia stata mostrata con orgoglio è una differenza dal sistema a porte chiuse creato per le regate. Si può affermare che il processo progettuale lascerà qualcosa alla nautica e alle barche.⁠
⁠

Un’eccellenza della Difesa italiana nell’ambito della copertura aerea che opera sotto l’ombrello Nato è tornata operativa. In una nota l’Alleanza Atlantica ha comunicato che il Centro di comando e controllo aereo dispiegabile (DACCC, Deployable Air Command and Control Centre) che ha sede in Italia ha ripreso la piena operatività presso la propria struttura di addestramento e sperimentazione del sistema di comando e controllo aereo (ATTF). La sospensione era scattata dopo un’operazione di aggiornamento hardware e software.⁠
⁠
Costituito nel gennaio del 2013, il centro italiano ha raccolto l’eredità del Combined Air Operation Centre che nello stesso periodo, a seguito della riforma dei Comandi dell’Alleanza Atlantica, è stato trasferito presso la base spagnola di Torrejon vicino a Madrid. Il DACCC di Poggio Renatico (Ferrara) è responsabile dell’addestramento operativo del personale della Nato impegnato nelle proprie strutture della componente aerea: è anche l’unico ente di Comando e Controllo dell’Alleanza atlantica che può essere rischierato laddove operativamente si ritenesse essere necessario.⁠
⁠

Nel 2026, dal 1° gennaio al 15 settembre, in Italia sono stati registrati 2.076 grandi incendi boschivi, con oltre 1.200 chilometri quadrati bruciati. La Sicilia è la regione più colpita, con il 55% della superficie totale.⁠
⁠
Oltre il 30% delle aree bruciate si trova in zone protette. La provincia di Agrigento è la più colpita, con 222 chilometri quadrati devastati. L’Ispra invita a rafforzare la prevenzione e la gestione del territorio.⁠
⁠
Satelliti, droni e analisi dei dati possono migliorare il monitoraggio e la prevenzione degli incendi. Anche in Europa la situazione resta critica, soprattutto in Spagna, Francia, Italia, Croazia e Belgio.⁠
⁠

Alberto Angela individua la ricchezza dell’Italia nella sua biodiversità culturale, frutto di tremila anni di incontri tra civiltà, unita alla bellezza dei paesaggi e al clima che hanno ispirato grandi capolavori artistici.⁠
⁠
La cucina italiana custodisce tradizioni e storia, esprimendo una cultura fondata sulla convivialità e sul piacere di stare insieme. Anche film, serie e documentari contribuiscono a valorizzare il patrimonio nazionale e a stimolare la curiosità dei viaggiatori.⁠
⁠
In un mondo sempre più tecnologico, Angela sottolinea il valore del contatto umano e delle esperienze dirette. Per contrastare il sovraffollamento turistico, propone di promuovere borghi e luoghi meno conosciuti, coinvolgendo televisioni, circuiti turistici e realtà locali.⁠
⁠

ll progetto del nuovo Codice della strada introduce regole diverse per i pedoni. Prima di attraversare, dovranno verificare di essere stati visti dai conducenti e che i veicoli si stiano fermando.⁠
⁠
Sulle strisce sarà vietato compiere movimenti improvvisi. Di notte, fuori dai centri abitati e senza illuminazione pubblica, sarà obbligatorio indossare dispositivi retroriflettenti o utilizzare luci adeguate.⁠
⁠
Restano gli obblighi già previsti, come usare le strisce se presenti entro 100 metri. I conducenti dovranno comunque mantenere la massima cautela per prevenire incidenti.⁠

Dipende sempre da come si guarda il bicchiere, se mezzo pieno o mezzo vuoto. Ma il dato di fatto è che l’economia non osservata (ossia la somma di sommerso e illegale) in Italia vale 218,2 miliardi di euro. Considerata l’entità del problema, si può però individuare qualche segnale positivo negli ultimi dati relativi al 2024 diffusi dall’Istat.⁠
⁠
In primo luogo, la crescita sull’anno precedente (il 2023), che si era sempre caratterizzata nel tempo per incrementi più sostanziosi, si è attestata a un +0,3% rispetto a una crescita del Pil del 3,2%. L’incidenza sul Pil scende al 9,9% dal 10,2% dell’anno precedente, con una riduzione di 0,3 punti percentuali.⁠
⁠
Come spiega l’Istat, l’economia sommersa (ossia al netto delle attività illegali) si attesta a 198,4 miliardi (+0,8 miliardi rispetto all’anno precedente), mentre il valore delle attività illegali scende a 19,8 miliardi. Le unità di lavoro irregolari sono poco meno di 3,3 milioni, con un incremento di oltre 145mila unità rispetto al 2023.⁠
⁠

Building on our success in 2025, we’re setting out to cement our place in Edinburgh’s cultural scene and put muralism firmly on the map.

We can’t do this without your support. If EIMF aligns with your brand and you’re interested in sponsorship, get in touch today.

Keep an eye out for what’s coming. We promise, it’s going to be good. 👊

#EIMF #StreetArt #Muralism #Graffiti #UrbanArt #Scotland #Edinburgh

Partner with EIMF and align your brand with a dynamic celebration of art and innovation. By sponsoring EIMF, you will not only support the creation of thought-provoking and high-quality public artworks but also engage with diverse communities across Edinburgh.

Join us in our mission to elevate muralism and street art culture, integrate new technologies, and support artists in their creative journeys. Together, we can transform public spaces and foster a sense of community ownership and excitement. 

If this sounds like something you would like to get involved with or know someone who would, please contact us now via our website (🔗 link in bio).

#EIMF25 #Sponsorship #HiddenDoor #MuralFestival #StreetArt

We’re gearing up for our launch at EIMF and are looking for passionate people to get involved.

This launch is just the beginning, we’re building what we hope will become a lasting celebration of street art and muralism across Edinburgh for years to come.

Whether you’re an artist, a business, or simply someone who resonates with EIMF’s mission, we’d love to hear from you. Reach out through the contact form on our website, and let’s see how we can work together to spread the word and the art.

#EIMF25 #HiddenDoor #MuralFestival #StreetArt

This week we Lay to rest Brian “ @elphone “ McFeely. 
The Love and admiration that’s been coming from across the world since his passing has been nothing short of heart warming . The kindness ,encouragement , support and inspiration he brought to our creative community can never be underestimated. Many of us would not be the people we are today without him in our lives, however fleeting that may have been , his words and style have impacted us all . 
Let’s not forget as-well as being the undisputed King of Style he was a Son , Husband , Father , Brother , Nephew , cousin to the wonderful McFeely family . 
As we all wrestle with our Grief and thoughts our support and love goes out to all who knew him and were lucky enough to call him a friend . 
Time will Heal but never forget and we aim to support and promote his memory for years to come . 
Community is our strength and we want everyone to feel supported and free to reach out if you need to talk about this difficult period and the struggles we all face day to day. 
Be kind . Be more Elph . 

Peace and Love RIP ELPH … your Graffs were no to Shabberz ! X 

X Ross aka TRENCH X

If you're passing the Paper Factory, you might see a splash of colour on the office block at the front... 🎨

Working alongside Edinburgh International Mural Festival, we commissioned Residents Studio to create this mural at the entrance to this year’s festival ❤️

Founded by David Breen and Dair McCormick, Residents Studio is an artistic collective working across mural painting, design and creative placemaking. 

Great work guys!

Follow: @edinintmuralfest @residentsstudio 

ABOUT HIDDEN DOOR

Hidden Door opens up forgotten urban spaces for the public to explore and discover incredible music, art, theatre, film, dance, spoken word and more.

Our 2026 festival will take place from 3rd – 7th June at The Paper Factory in Edinburgh - a huge industrial site transformed for the arts.

Through our festivals we reveal hidden parts of the city and showcase new and emerging artists, musicians, theatre and film makers.

Hidden Door is a volunteer-run charity, with our work funded through ticket sales, sponsorship and fundraising. All money goes straight back into the festival and ensuring all of our creative contributors are fairly paid.

Hidden Door is supported by @creativescots through Multi-Year Funding.

#HiddenDoorFestival #Festival #Edinburgh

Working alongside @edinintmuralfest and @hiddendoorarts , the studio was commissioned to create a large format mural for the façade of this year’s festival site within the disused paper factory in Edinburgh.

Responding to the 2026 theme, Signs of the Times, the artists explored a collection of words and phrases gathered by the festival, eventually discovering a poem by Robert L. Fulghum scrawled within the factory itself by a former worker. From this text, the phrase “paint and draw and sing and dance” became the foundation of the piece. A line that reflected the spirit of Hidden Door and the transformation of forgotten industrial spaces into places of creativity.

#hiddendoorfestival #eimf #edinburgh

Something new is on its way to Mural Park!

Last year’s murals are being removed as we prepare the boards for nine new murals at International Mural Fest 2026. It may look a little bare for now, but from 1-7 November, artists will bring this year’s theme, ‘Paint Me A Song’, to life.

Come along to Sheffield and watch the murals take shape. We can’t wait to see what the artists create!

We mourn the passing of one of Sheffield’s great mural artists, John Eathorne of West Tamar, Tasmania.

John left a lasting mark on our town, painting many beautiful murals and achieving recognition as a multi International Mural Fest Finalist. 

Across a career spanning more than four decades, John worked as a freelance commercial artist specialising in sign writing, murals, and fine art portraiture with projects commissioned throughout Australia and internationally. 

You will be greatly missed John, but your work and your legacy will remain part of Sheffield and the Kentish Municipality forever. ❤️

Recognize these murals? 👀 Find them inside the SHINE 10 Year Anniversary Book, along with the stories behind a decade of SHINE Mural Festival murals, artists, and the creative spirit that transformed St. Pete.

Whether you're a mural enthusiast, collector, or simply love our city's public art, this book is the perfect way to bring SHINE home.

Get your copy via the link in our bio.

Thank you to everyone who voted! Because of your support, the SHINE Mural Festival has been named Best Public Art in the St. Pete Life Magazine Readers’ Choice Best of 2026 Awards. 🎉

The SHINE Book continues to share stories from our local arts community ✨ 

More than a publication, it’s a living collection of the artists, stories, and moments shaping St. Petersburg’s cultural landscape.

It’s something you can bring home, share with someone who inspires you, or gift to a client, colleague, or organization that values creativity and culture.

The SHINE Book is available for purchase, grab your copy and experience the stories inside. Have you gotten your SHINE Book yet? If not, you can grab yours through the link in our bio.

SHINE Origins was a return to the heart of the festival, intentional, grounded, and deeply connected to place. We’re proud of what unfolded and grateful to everyone who showed up, supported, and believed in the process.

latestIgtvVideos.title: Uluwatu Single Fin Classic 2019
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
In a magnificent climax to the second annual Uluwatu Single Fin Classic, Australia’s Ozzie Wright had the honor of hoisting the perpetual championship trophy, joined by his fellow finalists and the cheers of the thousands of spectators, friends and competitors that gathered for this unique and vibrant event in celebration of single fin surfing. “This is my most favorite place in the whole world…I really didn’t care about winning, just being out there with all the guys, good kinship, and being able to express myself, the froth that I feel for life, is what it’s all about really” said Ozzy before jumping on stage. 
The grand prize for the event champion was an air ticket to join the 2020 Burleigh Single Fin Festival, now a sister event to the Uluwatu Single Fin Classic, but seeing how Ozzie is already in Australia, Tai Graham and Made Kasim decided to give air tickets to the finalists @agusblackysetiawan  and Dex Scoot for their amazing performances in the event.

What an incredible weekend at the Vanlife Gathering 2026 🚐✨

I was so grateful to be a part of the event this year, representing Compact Innovations and hosting the Vanlife Gathering Show & Shine.

The Show & Shine gave everyone the chance to wander through some seriously impressive builds, meet new people, swap ideas and inspire each other with all the clever, creative and completely different ways people have built their homes on wheels.

One of my favourite parts was getting to award three standout builds:

🏆 Best Style
Won by @thevanginas @sunny.soul.journey 
🏆 Best Tech
Won by @teeclarke24 & @leeroy_250  with a complete @victron_energy  fitout
🏆 Best Fitout
Won by @livanlifeco 

There was so much thought, personality and innovation throughout the whole gathering, and it was amazing to see just how much passion goes into every build.

A huge thank you to everyone who opened up their vans, got involved, voted and helped make the Show & Shine such a fun part of the weekend.

And of course, a massive thank you to @vanlifediaries for putting on another amazing event and continuing to bring this incredible community together year after year. 🤍

So grateful Compact Innovations could be involved in it all.

Heartwood | Linda Fredheim - Myrtle Cabinets

Linda has been working with timber for over 30 years, completing a BFA (Design in Wood) at the University of Tasmania’s School of Art in 1992.  Her work has been exhibited nationally and internationally, and she has held teaching roles at the UTAS School of Art as well as the Sturt School for Wood in Mittagong, NSW.

Linda's Myrtle cabinets, showing in the Heartwood exhibition and part of the Design Tasmania Wood Collection,  reflect Linda’s interest in surface decoration and the process of labelling, cataloguing, and storage.  The motifs on the label and inside each drawer represent the real or imaginary imprint left by an object. The cabinets are small personal pieces of furniture, identical in shape, but different in their detailing. They are designed to be together but almost have their own separate personalities. 

Like many of Linda’s other cabinets, the attention to detailing means the viewer has to interact with and use the piece to fully appreciate it.  Link in bio to read more about Linda and her meticulous timber work.

Heartwood: Tasmanian Women in Timber runs at Design Tasmania until 8 February 2026, celebrating the creative leadership and enduring impact of women in timber.

It's never too late to decide you could have done something better. Kurv 2 (2021) was never quite right. So 10 days ago I took the plunge and cut out the offending sides, before remaking them with a different grain orientation, fuller curve and better proportions. Ugly duckling now transformed.😊

Bag 11 heading off to rethink/remake/refine at the Schoolhouse Gallery, Rosny Farm. 
Bag 11 combines just a couple of "almost" ellipses - a step forward, I feel in terms of the design, but a look back to the original mould that set me on this path.
Last day today of my last designedmade makers market at the Hobart Town Hall. It's been a privilege helping to organise this annual event over the last 10 years with a great crew. Thanks everyone

That's it. Prototype done and dusted (but still needs a bit more finish!)
 See it at the @designedmadetas makers market Dec 6th-8th

So far so good. I have needed a few tweaks to my patterns and jigs along the way, but hopefully I have got the maths right to enable me to fit the side panels into band. Next step is to rebate the band for the side panels.

I recently travelled to Japan for four weeks. A key instigator was to feel inspired again, to create wildly and freely in the little time I have outside a day job. 
I searched and searched for inspiration-for the contemplative and considered Japan I remembered from living there 25 years ago. What I felt was an almost constant assault on the senses. Noise, colour, signs, objects, vying for attention in big sprawling modern grey and brown cities. I  craved, and found quiet moments in country areas, places where time felt as if it stood still, that modern Japan has forgotten and left behind.  I took along a journal with me that I hardly touched until I returned home. 
The inspiration I found instead, was of a desire for quietness and solitude and feeling comfortable with that. 
I revisited this relief print I did on linen some time ago that I never knew what to do with. After some slight modifications, it now sits under a beautiful cast iron tea pot I bought at a tea house in Kyoto. 
In reflecting on my trip, I plan to be more considered, to trust my gut, enjoy making again, and create what I like first and foremost. My pieces don’t have to be perfect and orderly like past work. And I hope in the end, I’m comfortable with that.
#handmade #thequiet #embracingsolitude
